## What changes for users?

Describe the incorrect result or the workflow this improves. Link the issue.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests demonstrate the changed behavior, including a failure or edge case.
- [ ] Typecheck and generated-artifact checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation explains any changed command or report field.
- [ ] New fixtures include their creator, source and license.

For package or release changes, include the packed-install smoke result.
